## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 177 captures during April 2019. Activity was completed as part of the site’s routine imaging service. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. No additional operational exceptions are noted in the information provided.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There were 4 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 2.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The ungradable result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, with any recurring issues considered as part of normal site oversight.

## Grading

Grading identified 29 referable results from the month’s activity. The median lag from capture to grading was 7. This measure provides an indication of the usual interval between image acquisition and completion of grading. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, the proportion of captures that could not be graded, and the number of referable results for April 2019.
